jobs.title: ML Engineering Team Lead
jobs.description: ML Engineering Team Lead - Shopic ML Engineering Team Lead Full-time Tel-Aviv R&D Shopic is a leading AI company specializing in next-generation retail technology. Our AI-powered Computer Vision solutions transform retail through intelligent, real-time visual analytics. From AI-driven loss prevention for self-checkout to Smart Cart technology and other vision-based retail solutions, we leverage Computer Vision and Machine Learning to help retailers reduce shrink, improve operational efficiency, and deliver seamless shopping experiences. Our technology is deployed by major grocery retailers worldwide, and we're building one of the most advanced Edge AI platforms in the retail industry. We're looking for an experienced and passionate ML Engineering Team Lead to lead our ML Engineering team and shape the next generation of our AI infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll combine technical leadership, software architecture, and people management to build scalable, production-ready AI systems running on edge devices. About The Role Lead, mentor, recruit, and grow a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Own the team's technical roadmap, architecture, execution, and project prioritization, aligning delivery with business goals. Design, build, and maintain scalable software and ML infrastructure across cloud and edge environments. Partner with AI Researchers to productionize Computer Vision and Deep Learning models into reliable, high-performance systems. Design and optimize inference pipelines with a focus on scalability, latency, and reliability. Drive engineering excellence through architecture reviews, code reviews, development best practices, and modern AI-assisted engineering workflows. Your Experience & Skills 6+ years of software development experience, including 3+ years leading software engineering or ML engineering teams. Strong hands-on experience with Python and C++ or Rust. Experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-grade Machine Learning systems. Strong understanding of software architecture, scalable system design, and performance optimization. Experience collaborating with AI, Machine Learning, or Computer Vision teams. Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with a strong ownership mindset. Experience using modern AI-assisted development tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex) while maintaining high engineering quality. Nice to Have Hands-on experience developing and optimizing AI applications on NVIDIA edge platforms, particularly NVIDIA Jetson devices, including GPU acceleration and deployment on resource-constrained systems. Experience with modern AI and Computer Vision frameworks such as PyTorch, CUDA, TensorRT, NVIDIA DeepStream, and GStreamer. Experience with containerized and cloud-native development using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Experience using agentic AI coding tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) as part of the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity while maintaining code quality and best practices. Why Join Us? Build AI products deployed by leading retailers around the world. Lead a highly technical team working on real-world Edge AI challenges. Work alongside world-class AI researchers and software engineers. Influence product direction, architecture and engineering culture. Solve complex engineering problems at the intersection of AI, Computer Vision and retail innovation. Apply to this job Error: Contact form not found. jobs.title: QA Tech Lead
jobs.description: QA Tech Lead - Shopic QA Tech Lead Tel-Aviv R&D Shopic is a leading AI company specializing in cutting-edge solutions for the retail industry. We develop advanced AI technologies that transform in-store shopping experiences, helping retailers optimize operations, enhance customer engagement, and drive growth. Our products harness computer vision, real-time data analytics, and powerful AI models to provide seamless, innovative solutions tailored to the needs of modern grocery and retail chains worldwide. Based in Tel Aviv, we are deployed in major grocery brands globally and employ some of the brightest minds in AI and Computer Vision. We are looking for a passionate and experienced QA Tech Lead to take ownership of quality across our products and lead our QA efforts from a technical perspective. This is a senior, hands-on role , focused on manual testing , technical leadership, and close collaboration with multidisciplinary R&D teams. As a QA Tech Lead, you will shape QA methodologies, lead the QA team technically, and ensure the delivery of high-quality, reliable systems built on AI, computer vision, and hardware–software integrated solutions . You will thrive in a high-pace, dynamic environment with frequently changing priorities, while maintaining high professional standards and strong cross-team collaboration. This is a full-time, on-site position (5 days a week from the office) . About The Role Perform hands-on manual testing of complex AI-driven and HW-SW integrated systems Define, implement, and continuously improve QA processes, methodologies, and best practices Own quality throughout the full product lifecycle, from requirements to production Plan QA activities based on business and technical priorities, adapting quickly to changing needs Work closely with all R&D teams Identify risks, prioritize issues effectively, and ensure timely and high-quality deliveries Strengthen the company’s quality culture by promoting ownership, accountability, and collaboration Lead the QA team technically , providing hands-on guidance and setting high standards for quality Your Experience & Skills Bachelor's degree in a relevant field. Minimum 5+ years of QA experience (mandatory) 2+ years of experience as a Tech Lead/Team Leader Senior-level QA profile with proven technical leadership capabilities Experience as a QA Tech Lead or Team Lead (preferred) Strong background in manual testing of complex systems Hands-on experience with at least one of the following domains: AI-based or Computer Vision systems Hardware- Software solutions Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to distinguish between critical and non-critical tasks Proven ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities Strong sense of ownership, independence, and accountability A true team player , and someone who is professional, reliable, and great to work with Apply to this job Error: Contact form not found. Prevent losses, protect revenue, and maintain smooth checkout. Request a Demo hello world! hello world! Innovation Smart Cart. The Smart Way Attached in one click, Shop-E turns any regular shopping cart into a smart cart See full-screen Bringing the best of shopping online to physical stores Shop-E enables personalized, interactive, and frictionless shopping journeys with efficient, data-driven store operations Our Solution Curb Retail Shrinkage with Shopic Powered by real-time AI and item-level recognition, Shopic prevents self-checkout fraud instantly with nearly zero friction. ✓ Edge-based AI for real-time loss prevention ✓ > 90% fraud detection accuracy ✓ SCO & POS systems agnostic ✓ Minimal false positives ✓ Cloud-native scalability for effortless deployment How It Works See It. Detect It. Stop It. By leveraging Computer Vision to accurately recognize items at checkout, Shopic prevents scan errors, minimizes loss, and delivers actionable insights, seamlessly integrating with existing point-of-sale systems. Edge Processing Advanced computer vision and AI-powered solution, enabling real-time item recognition and fraud detection. Item-Level Recognition Advanced vision algorithms reduce false alerts through visual validation, preventing fraud techniques even in challenging conditions. Real-Time Reporting & Actionable Insights A powerful analytics engine with live transaction monitoring, loss prevention reports, and fraud alerts. Simple Add-on Integration Seamlessly integrates with existing self-checkout systems, providing real-time alerts for potential discrepancies. AI-Powered Security Transforming Retail with Vision Technology. Today. Secure Every Checkout Touchpoint Smarter fraud detection. Seamless integration. Zero disruptions. ✓ Loss Prevention & Accuracy Item-Level Recognition: Recognizes tens of thousands of SKUs, not just object movement or gestures. Reduced False Positives: High-accuracy vision minimizes unnecessary alerts. Real-Time Fraud Detection Monitoring: Provides instant fraud detection and accurate shrinkage data. ✓ Optimized Checkout & Workforce Efficiency Automatic Self-Correction: Suggests item corrections in real-time, reducing manual rescans. Smarter Attendant Alerts: Employees focus on real risks instead of false alarms. Faster and Seamless Checkout: Minimizes interruptions. ✓ Seamless, Low-Cost Integration Edge-Based Processing: On device , no need for store servers or special network setups. Compact Hardware Add-On: Easily integrates with self-checkouts. Cloud Sync for Updates: Ensures continuous AI model improvements. Request a Demo Computer Vision Insights Real-Time Reporting & Actionable Insights Shopic's solution isn’t just a loss prevention tool, it’s a powerful analytics engine for retailers. Live transaction monitoring Get real-time visibility into self-checkout activity. Loss Prevention report Anomaly detection, fraud patterns and trends analysis across locations. Automated fraud alerts Notify store associates instantly when intervention is needed. Benefits Vision Enhanced Checkout Optimal Intervention Configurable security and business rules ensure targeted and effective responses. High-Impact Detection Scalable computer vision algorithms accurately recognize large product catalogs. Seamless Integration Edge processing with a lightweight hardware add-on ensures zero disruption. Rapid Deployment Minimal modifications required for existing checkout HW and SW. Actionable Insights Detailed reports and analytics enable continuous optimization. Business Impact Enhance shopper experience, prevent losses, and improve SCO efficiency. jobs.title: About us
jobs.description: About us - Shopic Transforming Retail with Vision Technology. Today. Our Story Smooth Shopping, Smarter Checkout, Powered by Computer Vision & AI Bringing Intelligence to Every Touchpoint Shopic provides store digitalization solutions, blending the best of online commerce with physical retail. Our AI and computer vision technologies create personalized, seamless shopping experiences while empowering retailers with data-driven optimization to enhance operations and reduce losses. We envision a future where shopping is intuitive, stores are data-driven, and loss prevention is effortless—without disrupting the shopper experience. By harnessing real-time AI and computer vision, Shopic transforms every aspect of the retail journey. AI-Powered Smart Cart: Frictionless, Personalized Shopping Our unique clip-on device turns any standard shopping cart into a smart cart for the duration of a visit. Using computer vision and AI, it delivers: (1) Automated product recognition and checkout - Ensuring a frictionless experience. (2) Retail media and promotions – Hyper-targeted offers and ads, displayed exactly when and where shoppers select products. (3) Real-time analytics – Insights on shopper behavior, store inventory, and operational efficiency. Computer Vision-Powered Loss Prevention Shopic’s add-on secures every checkout touchpoint, reducing fraud and protecting revenue while maintaining a smooth shopper experience. Powered by real-time AI and product-level recognition, Shopic prevents self-checkout fraud instantly with ✓ 94%+ fraud detection accuracy ✓ Edge-based AI for real-time loss prevention ✓ Seamless integration with any SCO & POS systems ✓ Minimal false positives ✓ Cloud-native solution for rapid, scalable deployment With Shopic’s vision technology, retailers enhance security, streamline checkout, and unlock new revenue opportunities. Work with us Always Looking for Exceptional Talent Want to help us create new shopping experiences? View open positions Our people A Team of Stars Shopic’s team is one of the most experienced and capable forces in retail tech. It has created multiple AI-based solutions and gone through numerous development and deployment cycles. At heart, we are a software and data company. Still, we also design hardware, orchestrate manufacturing, integrate solutions in live commercial environments, and work intensively with our customers on the retail floor. It takes a special team to succeed in such a multidisciplinary endeavor. We have one. Management Team Eran Kravitz CTO & Co-Founder Gonzalo Troncoso Chief Financial Officer Raz Golan CEO & Co-Founder Rani Wellingstein Chief Strategy Officer Avinoam Bloch Chief Operations Officer Roger Bigio Chief Revenue Officer Hanan Lifshitz Chief Product Officer Investors Backed by Leading Financial and Industry Players Our certifications Product Certifications EMC certified CE safety certified VCCI certified RoHs compliant WEEE ISO/IEC 27001:2013 certified GDPR compliant ESG Environmental, Social, and Governance Read how Shopic promotes a cleaner environment, provides fair and inclusive working conditions to its employees, keeps its customers’ data secure and guards shoppers’ privacy.
